newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Robinsons says 95/96 net up on brisk sales.
newsitem.headline: Robinsons says 95/96 net up on brisk sales.

text.p: Robinson's Land Corp, the property arm of JG Summit Holdings Corp, said on Monday its full-year earnings ended September 1996 was buoyed by improved shopping center performance and brisk sales of the Robinsons-PCIBank Tower.
Increased hotel revenues and the start of its housing sales also helped the bottomline, it said.
Robinson's Land reported on Monday a net profit of 600.11 million pesos for the fiscal year ended September 1996, up 79 percent from the 335.1 million in the year-ago period.
Revenues rose to 1.689 billion from 965.56 million pesos.
Robinson's earnings performance was in line with most analysts' forecasts of a net of 605 million pesos based on the latest Estimates Directory.

The company said its flagship Robinsons Galleria mall was expanded in December last year, which would significantly boost customer traffic this year. The expansion housed 90 shops, 12 food outlets and two major family entertainment centers.
It also opened another shopping center late last year in Negros Occidental in the central Philippines.
The 45-storey Robinsons-PCIBank Tower's saleable space was 67 percent sold valued at 1.7 billion pesos, the company said.

Hotel operating revenues rose to 303.46 million from 253.26 million pesos, the company said. The Manila Galleria Suites hotel registered an average 86 percent occupancy rate versus the previous year's 78 percent.
Group revenues from its housing units, Robinsons Homes Inc and Trion Homes Development Corp, amounted to 142.27 million pesos, the company said.

This year, the company said it will launch two major building projects: Robinsons Place Residences and JG Summit Center. The first phase of Robinsons Place Residences includes two 38-storey condominium buildings linked to the Robinsons Place-Manila shopping mall, while the JG Summit Center is a 37-storey building along plush Ayala Avenue in the financial district of Makati.
